uninstallImpact: One Cloudflare AI Gateway bundle switch atomically changes the Settings → Models card and the account default for the Think platform model service. Both runtime plugins remain separate composition entries, and legacy member toggle/reset requests target the whole owner bundle. Explicit Session overrides still apply; in-flight cancellation is not promised. Owner BYOK remains independent and packages stay installed; deployment opt-out cannot be overridden by account or Session selection. Legacy split selections follow the Think provider decision without changing execution intent.

reuse.reason: No official DSH package supplies a Cloudflare AI Gateway Think provider or a platform Gateway provider card. The Think provider reuses the pinned official model catalog; the client card reuses the pinned official Models row/editor slot contract. Platform usage is an explicit operator opt-in, off by default.
